instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium shot. Next to a textured white wall in bright daylight, the man in the beige polo shirt (R1) stands on the left, looking directly at the camera with a relaxed expression. The woman in the black strapless top and white jacket (R2) stands on the right, leaning her arm on the wall behind him and looking at him with a warm smile. Strong sunlight from the left casts sharp shadows on the wall.
